verdict.rationale: Phaser is itself the official SDK: a first-party npm package (`npm install phaser`, verified live at 4.2.1, MIT) that ships full TypeScript definitions, a CDN build, and an official CLI that scaffolds project templates. Developers can build against it in JavaScript or TypeScript. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond the JS/TS package (no other languages), independent hands-on corroboration of the current TypeScript typings' quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Full TypeScript definitions can be found inside the types folder... modern editors such as VSCode will detect them automatically.
This CLI tool presents an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games.
You can use JavaScript or TypeScript for development.
